items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: Well, my mother used to be a school teacher and my father, he was, well in the earlier days he was a railroad man, and then he went to law school and he studied to be an attorney.

ctx.x: Alright? You're going to tell me about your parents.

Well, if you want me to start there, alright. Well, I had the best parents in the world, I'll say that, because they were. Well, my mother used to be a school teacher and my father, he was, well in the earlier days he was a railroad man, and then he went to law school and he studied to be an attorney. And then in the later years he was a real estate man.
Helen, about your father being an attorney, wasn't that a little unusual in those days?
